name: footer
title: Footer
description: Site footer with six layouts: link columns, centered, newsletter card, giant wordmark, closing call to action, and a compact one-line bar.

props.name: variant
props.description: columns: brand left, link columns right. centered: minimal stack. newsletter: subscribe card above the columns. big-brand: giant cropped wordmark. cta: large call to action above a small footer. compact: one line for apps.

props.name: brand
props.description: Logo or site name.

props.name: description
props.description: Short line under the brand. In the cta variant it sits under the heading instead. Hidden in compact.

props.name: columns
props.description: Link groups. columns, newsletter, and big-brand show them as titled columns; centered, cta, and compact show all links in one row.

props.name: socials
props.description: Social links shown as icon buttons. icon is an SVG path (d) for a 24px stroke icon; label becomes the accessible name.

props.name: legal
props.description: Small links next to the copyright, such as Privacy and Terms.

props.name: copyright
props.description: Copyright line in the bottom row.

props.name: heading
props.description: Heading of the call to action block (cta variant).

props.name: newsletterDescription
props.description: Text under the newsletter card heading (newsletter variant).

props.name: wordmark
props.description: Text of the giant wordmark (big-brand variant). It scales to the footer width and is cropped at the bottom.

props.name: backToTop
props.description: Adds a Back to top link to #top. Works without JavaScript.

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra content under the description, such as app store badges. In the cta variant: the buttons of the call to action block.

props.name: newsletter
props.description: Replaces the built-in subscribe form, for example with a form that posts to your email provider.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the link navigation.

props.name: legalLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the legal links navigation.

props.name: socialLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the social links list.

props.name: newsletterLabel
props.description: Heading of the newsletter card.

props.name: emailLabel
props.description: Accessible name and placeholder of the email field.

props.name: subscribeLabel
props.description: Text of the subscribe button.

props.name: successLabel
props.description: Message announced in a status region after a valid email is submitted.

props.name: backToTopLabel
props.description: Text of the Back to top link.

a11y: Uses a footer element, a nav labelled by navLabel for the links, and a separate nav labelled by legalLabel for legal links.
Column titles and card headings are h2 elements, and every group of links is a list.
Social links are icon only, so each gets aria-label from its label and the icon is aria-hidden.
The subscribe form uses native email validation; the success message is placed in a role=status region so screen readers announce it.
The giant wordmark is decorative and aria-hidden; the brand slot stays the accessible name.
User hrefs with unsafe schemes such as javascript: are replaced with #.

ai.whenToUse: The bottom of a marketing site, landing page, docs site, or app shell, to group secondary navigation, legal links, and social profiles.
rules: Use columns for sites with many pages, centered or compact when there are only a few links
Use cta only on landing pages, with at most two buttons in actions
Keep column titles short nouns and limit each column to about six links
The built-in newsletter form does not send data; pass the newsletter slot with your own form to actually subscribe people
Pass a 24px stroke icon path for each social link and a clear label such as LinkedIn

id.description: Footer situs dengan enam tata letak: kolom link, tengah, kartu newsletter, wordmark raksasa, ajakan penutup, dan bar ringkas satu baris.

props.variant: columns: brand di kiri, kolom link di kanan. centered: tumpukan minimalis. newsletter: kartu langganan di atas kolom. big-brand: wordmark raksasa terpotong. cta: ajakan besar di atas footer kecil. compact: satu baris untuk aplikasi.
props.description: Kalimat singkat di bawah brand. Pada varian cta tampil di bawah judul. Disembunyikan pada compact.
props.columns: Kelompok link. columns, newsletter, dan big-brand menampilkannya sebagai kolom berjudul; centered, cta, dan compact menampilkan semua link dalam satu deret.
props.socials: Link media sosial berupa tombol ikon. icon adalah path SVG (d) untuk ikon garis 24px; label menjadi nama aksesibel.
props.legal: Link kecil di samping hak cipta, misalnya Privasi dan Ketentuan.
props.copyright: Baris hak cipta di baris bawah.
props.heading: Judul blok ajakan (varian cta).
props.newsletterDescription: Teks di bawah judul kartu newsletter (varian newsletter).
props.wordmark: Teks wordmark raksasa (varian big-brand). Ukurannya mengikuti lebar footer dan terpotong di bawah.
props.backToTop: Menambah link Kembali ke atas menuju #top. Jalan tanpa JavaScript.
props.actions: Konten tambahan di bawah deskripsi, misalnya lencana app store. Pada varian cta: tombol blok ajakan.
props.newsletter: Pengganti form langganan bawaan, misalnya form yang mengirim ke penyedia email Anda.
props.navLabel: Label aksesibel navigasi link. Isi "Footer" atau "Navigasi kaki" untuk situs berbahasa Indonesia.
props.socialLabel: Label aksesibel daftar link media sosial.
props.emailLabel: Nama aksesibel dan placeholder kolom email.
props.successLabel: Pesan yang dibacakan lewat region status setelah email valid dikirim.

a11y: Memakai elemen footer, nav berlabel navLabel untuk link, dan nav terpisah berlabel legalLabel untuk link legal.
Judul kolom dan judul kartu adalah h2, dan setiap kelompok link berupa daftar.
Link media sosial hanya berupa ikon, jadi masing-masing diberi aria-label dari label dan ikonnya aria-hidden.
Form langganan memakai validasi email native; pesan sukses ada di region role=status sehingga dibacakan pembaca layar.
Wordmark raksasa bersifat dekoratif dan aria-hidden; slot brand tetap menjadi nama aksesibel.
Href dari user dengan skema berbahaya seperti javascript: diganti #.

ai.whenToUse: Bagian bawah situs pemasaran, landing page, situs dokumentasi, atau kerangka aplikasi, untuk mengelompokkan navigasi sekunder, link legal, dan profil media sosial.
rules: Pakai columns untuk situs dengan banyak halaman, centered atau compact bila link hanya sedikit
Pakai cta hanya di landing page, dengan paling banyak dua tombol di actions
Judul kolom berupa kata benda pendek dan batasi tiap kolom sekitar enam link
Form newsletter bawaan tidak mengirim data; isi slot newsletter dengan form sendiri untuk benar-benar mendaftarkan pelanggan
Berikan path ikon garis 24px untuk tiap link sosial dan label yang jelas seperti LinkedIn
